This index records short names found in the source's nature title section.

A label alone does not establish where something grows, whether it can be harvested, what it yields, or whether it is currently accessible. Such behavior needs separate evidence.

'''Spoilers:''' browsing names can reveal undiscovered content. This page does not reproduce the source's descriptive prose.
